title: Grade 8 French — Thu, Jun 19
description: Le futur simple — Day 4 of 5: Futur simple vs conditionnel présent; predictions vs hypotheticals
subject: french

questions.question: The conditionnel présent uses the same STEM as the futur simple but different endings. What are the conditionnel endings?
questions.explanation: Conditionnel présent = futur stem + imperfect endings: -ais/-ais/-ait/-ions/-iez/-aient. Same STEM as futur, different ENDINGS.

questions.question: Compare: 'je parlerai' vs 'je parlerais'. What is the difference?
options: No difference — both mean 'I will speak'
parlerai = futur simple (I will speak); parlerais = conditionnel (I would speak)
questions.explanation: parlerai (futur: -ai ending) = I WILL speak. parlerais (conditionnel: -ais ending) = I WOULD speak. The extra -s marks the conditionnel.

questions.question: When do we use the futur simple?
options: For wishes, polite requests, and hypotheticals
For definite future plans and predictions about what WILL happen
questions.explanation: Futur simple = what WILL happen (certain future, predictions, plans). Example: 'Il pleuvra demain.' (It will rain tomorrow.)

questions.question: When do we use the conditionnel présent?
options: For hypotheticals, polite requests, and what WOULD happen (if something else happened)
questions.explanation: Conditionnel présent = what WOULD happen. Used for hypotheticals (si + imperfect → conditionnel), polite requests, and unconfirmed news.

questions.question: Choose the correct tense: 'Demain, il _____ (pleuvoir) sûrement.' (sûrement = certainly)
questions.explanation: 'Sûrement' (certainly) + demain (tomorrow) = definite prediction → futur simple. Il pleuvra = it will rain.

questions.question: Choose the correct tense: 'Si j'avais de l'argent, j'_____ un vélo.' (acheter = to buy)
questions.explanation: 'Si + imperfect → conditionnel'. This is a hypothetical (if I had money, I WOULD buy). j'achèterais = conditionnel.

questions.question: Identify the tense: 'Nous irions au parc si le soleil brillait.'
questions.explanation: irions = ir- (aller stem) + -ions (conditionnel ending). 'We would go to the park if the sun shone.' Conditionnel présent.

questions.question: Identify the tense: 'Ils seront prêts à 8h.'
questions.explanation: seront = ser- (être futur stem) + -ont = futur simple. 'They will be ready at 8.' Definite future statement.

questions.question: A polite request in French often uses: 'Je _____ un café, s'il vous plaît.'
questions.explanation: Polite requests use the conditionnel: 'Je voudrais...' = 'I would like...' It is softer than 'je veux' (I want).

questions.question: The newspaper headline reads: 'Selon nos sources, le président démissionnerait.' (démissionner = to resign). What tense is 'démissionnerait' and why?
options: Futur simple — it is certain news
questions.explanation: 'Selon nos sources' (according to our sources) = unconfirmed. French uses conditionnel to report unverified news. démissionnerait = 'is said to resign / would resign'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Si tu étudiais plus, tu _____ mieux à l'examen.' (réussir = to succeed)
questions.explanation: si + imperfect (étudiais) → conditionnel. 'If you studied more, you WOULD do better on the exam.' réussirais = conditionnel.

questions.question: Compare these two sentences. Which is FUTUR SIMPLE?
options: 'Il fera ses devoirs ce soir.' (futur simple)
questions.explanation: fera = fer- + -a (futur simple ending). ferait = fer- + -ait (conditionnel ending). 'Il fera ses devoirs ce soir' = He will do his homework tonight.

questions.question: Fill in with the correct tense of 'avoir': 'L'année prochaine, vous _____ un nouveau professeur.'
questions.explanation: 'L'année prochaine' (next year) = certain future event → futur simple. aur- + -ez = vous aurez.

questions.question: Which sentence expresses a HYPOTHETICAL wish using conditionnel?
options: Tu finiras tes devoirs ce soir.
questions.explanation: 'J'adorerais' = conditionnel of adorer. 'I would love to visit Paris one day.' — a wish/hypothetical, not a definite plan.

questions.question: Summary: futur simple endings are _____, conditionnel endings are _____.
questions.explanation: Key difference: futur = -ai/-as/-a/-ons/-ez/-ont. Conditionnel = -ais/-ais/-ait/-ions/-iez/-aient. Same STEM, different ENDINGS.
